BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to discrimination against chiropractors; adding anew section to chapter 48.43 RCW; providing an effective date; anddeclaring an emergency.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 48.43 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) For the purpose of this section, "contractor" means thirdpartypayor as defined in RCW 70.02.010 and any organization engaged in thebusiness of creating health care provider networks for use by a thirdparty payor. (2) Contractors may not develop and employ provider paymentmethodologies that discriminate against chiropractors by settingdiffering payment formulas for a chiropractor's services than for adifferent profession's services when the contractor is reimbursing forthe same type of health care services. The contractor may not have amethodology that would pay chiropractors less than any other providerfor the same payment code.

This act is necessary for the immediatepreservation of the public peace, health, or safety, or support of thestate government and its existing public institutions, and takes effectJuly 1, 2007, and applies to all provider contracts that are executed,continued, or renewed on and after January 1, 2008, and to allreimbursement of services by contractors on and after January 1, 2008.
